title: Restriction preserves one localization complex and its augmentation
statement: Let C be a small site with topology J and commutative ring sheaf O. For every U and global section s, restriction along Over.forget U carries the chain arrow [O→O[1/s]]→O[0] to an arrow isomorphic to the analogous localization factor for O/U and s|U. For every f:V→U and every global section of O/U, the same assertion holds along Over.map f with the section restricted by precomposition. No derived category, finite tensor product, internal Hom or Koszul tower occurs.

proof.text: 1. The objectwise identity on fractions is an isomorphism from the restricted localization presheaf to the localization presheaf of the restricted section. The continuous cocontinuous restriction/sheafification comparison identifies the corresponding sheaves.

2. Apply the sheafification adjunction to its defining comparison equation. Restriction of the presheaf map sending one to one is the same local map under the fraction isomorphism. Naturality of the local sheafification unit then proves the localization-unit square, using the objectwise identity comparison of rank-one modules.

3. Use this square to construct a complex isomorphism in degrees zero and one, and the zero-object comparison elsewhere. The unique nonzero differential square is the localization-unit square. Compare ring complexes by single-map restriction, and check the augmentation in degree zero and in the zero degrees. Apply to Over.forget U and Over.map f.

proof_origin.note: Separated from the normalized comparison existence argument; finite-complex and categorical glue are written explicitly in Lean.

theorem exists_ringed_localization_factor_restriction :
    (∀ (U : C) (s : (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections), Nonempty
      (Arrow.mk
          (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
            ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O) U).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).map (ringedLocalizationTwoTermAugmentation O s)) ≅
        Arrow.mk (ringedLocalizationTwoTermAugmentation (O.over U)
          (ringedKoszulSliceSection O s U)))) ∧
    (∀ (U V : C) (f : V ⟶ U)
      (s : ((O.over U).obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections), Nonempty
      (Arrow.mk
          (((SheafOfModules.overMap.{u}
            ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O) f).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).map (ringedLocalizationTwoTermAugmentation (O.over U) s)) ≅
        Arrow.mk (ringedLocalizationTwoTermAugmentation (O.over V)
          (LocalizationRHom.restrictedSection (K := J.over V) (L := J.over U)
            (Over.map f) (O.over U) s))))
